title: WEATHER IN CAPS
why: His order of 2026-10-09: raid text reads like a shooter HUD, a short caps callout of at most 34 characters, never a sentence. The review of the seventh batch of raid text found the weather still said as sentences, such as Rain. It covers your noise, and theirs. at the drop and The weather is turning. Storm. Lightning lights up the map... when the sky starts to turn. Each sky now has a caps headline for the drop (RAIN, FOG, STORM, BLACKOUT, PARTLY CLOUDY; a clear sky still says nothing, his v6.68 note) and one for the turn (STORM INCOMING, RAIN INCOMING, FOG ROLLING IN, GRID GOING DOWN, CLOUDS ROLLING IN, SKIES CLEARING), with a short detail under it such as Covers your noise and theirs or Lightning shows you from farther off (his v16.03 order: farther, not across the whole map). The fog detail is his own v7.43 line, kept whole. Player 2 is told the turn the same way. The skies, their odds and their effects did not move.
now: The weather reads as a short caps callout, such as RAIN at the drop and STORM INCOMING when the sky turns.
